results.title: A Phase-Field Model Coupled with Large Elasto-Plastic Deformation: Application to Lithiated Silicon Electrodes
results.abstract: A phase-field model accounting for large elasto-plastic deformation is developed to study phase, morphology, and stress evolution in crystalline silicon electrodes during lithium insertion. Lithium concentration and deformation are co-evolved with coupled phase-field and mechanics equations solved by finite elements. The model is compared with a nonlinear concentration-dependent diffusion model and predicts a surface-layer hoop-stress transition from compression to tension that may explain experimentally observed cracking.
